voice: Installed macOS Daniel (English UK), synthetic narration; not a recording of Basil

parts.title: Hi, I’m Basil.
parts.caption: An old world. A new purpose.
parts.text: Hi, I'm Basil. I said Tania couldn't easily turn Career Empire into something Curios teachers could make their own. Well, here we are!

parts.title: Keep. Clear. Repurpose.
parts.caption: A few plain-English prompts.
parts.text: Her prompts were simple: keep the world, avatars, buildings and characters; remove the careers content; and leave the original untouched. The first explorable copy took about fifteen minutes. The teacher tools, branding, app rooms and testing came afterwards.

parts.title: Walk in. Open an app.
parts.caption: Archon Engine · ArtQuest · Loopy Tunes
parts.text: Now the campus is a shared front door for teacher-created apps. Follow a sign and walk inside to open Archon Engine, Art Quest or Loopy Tunes. Return to Curios brings you back. Avatar Studio is still here.

parts.title: Make it your own.
parts.caption: Preview · Share with ICT
parts.text: Teachers can change names, conversations and room links in Teacher setup. Preview your ideas, then give ICT the settings to publish. Your curriculum gives this world its purpose.

parts.title: Reuse. Repurpose. Recycle.
parts.caption: Learning Without Limits
parts.text: Reuse. Repurpose. Recycle. Curios: learning without limits. Apparently, you can teach an old N P C new tricks.
